create_manager_continuous_batching: create a ContinuousBatchingManager to handle continuous batching of LLM generation requests
run_batch_generate: run batch generation on a list of input token sequences using continuous batching with progress bar
add_request_streaming: add a generation request to the continuous batching queue with streaming token output
register_result_handler: register an async callback handler for continuous batching result delivery per request
warmup_cuda_graphs: warm up CUDA graphs for varlen and decode paths before starting continuous batching inference
